name: Hot Takes
description: Pick a card. Defend the opinion for 30 seconds — even if you don't believe it.

Cafeteria coffee is overrated
Most students learn more from YouTube than lectures
Internships should be mandatory for every degree
Libraries are the worst place to study
Student clubs matter more than coursework
AI should be allowed in every assessment
Living on campus is actually useful
Module based learning is useless
Exam stress is worse than assignment stress

Crocs are a must-have footwear item
You can wear denim on denim
